reference.message: `Supervisor` spawns `Worker`, granting it `shell.exec`, but `Supervisor` holds only `model.complete` — a spawn may narrow a child's capabilities, never widen them
`Top` spawns `Mid`, granting it `shell.exec`, but `Top` holds only `model.complete` — a spawn may narrow a child's capabilities, never widen them

note: Recorded by `python3 tools/gate_reference_census.py --record`. Every entry is a KNOWN gate/reference divergence over the census corpus; `--check` fails on one that is not here, and on one here that no longer diverges, so the allowance can only shrink in a diff somebody reads. A `false-admit` entry is an OPEN GATE BYPASS, not an accepted state: the list is capped by name in tests/test_gate_reference_census.py so it cannot grow quietly while it is worked down.
